ABOUT THE COMPANY:
This growing FinTech has a global presence and an AI driven platform that is disrupting their industry. They are scaling quickly and looking to grow their talented Sydney based development team.  Technology is evolving at super speed and this business is evolving with it, rethinking how tools need to work in a digital-first world.
They have a small but tight-knit team that are passionate about what they do and love solving meaningful problems.  If you want to make an impact way beyond code, then this is the place for you.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
You'll be joining a team that thrives on collaboration and shared goals, and are driven to make impactful decisions that benefit their customers and the business.  Your contribution will be truly recognised here.
Responsibilities will include:
Contribute to full-stack development: planning, design, coding, testing, deployment.
Write clean, maintainable code and comprehensive tests (unit, integration).
Review and provide constructive feedback on teammates’ code.
Collaborate with senior engineers to shape architecture and customer solutions.
Partner with the product team to scope features and provide technical insights.
Triage and resolve support tickets, bugs and performance issues.
Overseeing and guiding the analysing, writing, building, and deployment of software and supporting documentation.
ABOUT YOU:
Strong OOP fundamentals with a deep understanding of best practices, design patterns and practical application to build scalable, maintainable solutions.
Proficiency in frontend frameworks and Ruby on Rails.
Solid experience with PostgreSQL: schema design, writing efficient queries, indexing and performance tuning.
A passion for continuous learning, growth mindset and staying updated with emerging technologies.
Demonstrated ability to own mid-sized features end-to-end.
Growth mindset and passion for sharing knowledge
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
This business offers hybrid working with plenty of flexibility, career growth opportunities, and a competitive salary with equity options.
WHAT'S NEXT?
If you are ready to work somewhere where you can take ownership, grow your skills and help shape the future of this industry, then let's talk.  Apply today or contact Lisa on
lcooley@brightspark.io
for more details.
Don’t provide your bank or credit card details when applying for jobs.
